item.title: Democratic Ad Firm Works to Protect Insurance Company Profits
item.description: Bully Pulpit International, a leading Democratic digital firm, was paid millions in 2024 by a health insurance industry group that is working to ensure companies like UnitedHealth and Humana can continue overbilling Medicare.

item.title: Right-Wing Group Trains State Lawmakers to Cut the Safety Net
item.description: Sludge obtained a conference agenda from the Foundation for Government Accountability that uses the "One Big Beautiful Bill Act" as a launch pad for sweeping conservative policies like cuts to SNAP and Medicaid programs.

item.title: GOP Stock Trading Bill Leaves Glaring Conflicts Untouched
item.description: Senators and reps could continue to hold stock in companies they oversee on their committees under a GOP leadership-backed stock bill that is being fast-tracked through the House.

item.title: GOP Leader’s Family Buys xAI Stock Days Before Pentagon Integration
item.description: House Republican Conference chairwoman Lisa McClain disclosed the purchase made just days before the Pentagon announced a major integration with xAI.

item.title: The Companies Behind ICE
item.description: Sludge built an interactive map of every ICE contractor working with the Trump administration.

item.title: No Labels’ Israel Push Follows Foreign Agent Work by Spouse’s Firm
item.description: The group's leader is married to Mark Penn, whose Stagwell Group companies have recently been working as registered foreign agents for Israel.

item.title: Hudson River Park Trust to End Longstanding ICE Contract Following Sludge Report
item.description: After contracting with ICE since 2004, the Trust tells Sludge it will stop when the current contract ends in June.

item.title: Crypto, AI, and AIPAC Set up to Smash Super PAC Spending Records
item.description: The groups are sitting on massive war chests for 2026 midterms, according to new disclosures.

item.title: Foreign Interests Are Paying Millions to a Trump-Linked Lobbying Firm
item.description: Ballard Partners’ foreign-interest lobbying business has boomed since Trump took office, signing up new clients from Saudi Arabia, South Korea, Albania, Uzbekistan, and more.

item.title: Companies ‘Honor’ Trump With Kennedy Center Donations
item.description: From defense to oil to tech, new companies are supporting the Kennedy Center since Trump’s takeover while others are revising their disclosure practices to explicitly honor the president.
